title: Adjust lyric prosody before adding style tags
summary: Community hypothesis: line length, syllable count and repetition may influence vocal pacing and melodic variation. Model- and genre-specific verification is needed.

build.target: Investigate whether deliberate syllable lengths, repetition and pauses improve rushed vocal phrasing in an original song.
requires: Owned lyrics with right to alter
Same Suno model, generation mode and other controls for compared takes
Suno credit approval for actual generations
inputs: Observed problem: rushing, breathlessness or repetition
outputs: Two prosodic lyric alternatives with a change log
execute: Mark suspected crowded lines and natural breath positions.
Prepare one variant with shorter/simpler phrases and one baseline, preserving meaning and style.
Keep the Suno prompt/controls stable and change only the nominated prosodic variable.
Generate at the approved candidate count, randomize audition order and record actual sung timing.
Document any improvement, regression or inability to interpret.

applies_when: Vocals rush across line breaks or lack breathing space.
Melody interacts awkwardly with long or dense lines.
avoid_when: A change to prosody would overwrite the user's deliberately fixed lyrics.

operator: Do not change copyrighted third-party lyrics.
Budget candidate count in advance; no iterative spend without renewed authority.

stop_when: Prosody variants and evaluation method are recorded.
A fixed budget or feature/permission error terminates trial.

checks: Measure approximate syllables per audible second and listener-reported breathing naturalness.
Keep null or worse outcomes as negative evidence.
